channel.title: Bible Answer
channel.description: Reading guides and news from Bible Answer.

item.title: Where to start reading the Bible
item.description: Choose a manageable first Bible reading, explore the Gospel of John, and use four simple questions to understand a passage before applying it.

item.title: What comes after “I’m sorry”?
item.description: Read Ephesians 4:25–32 in context and explore what kindness, honest words, and a concrete repair can add to an apology in an ordinary conversation.

item.title: Gratitude on a hard day
item.description: Read 1 Thessalonians 5:14–22 alongside its words about patience and care, then try an honest prayer that names both a difficulty and a gift.

item.title: Asking for wisdom before a decision
item.description: Read James 1:2–8 in context, understand its invitation to ask for wisdom, and use a simple reflection to name one missing piece of information.

item.title: Bible verses for anxiety: prayer and care
item.description: Read Philippians 4:6–7 and 1 Peter 5:6–7 with context, an honest prayer exercise, and questions for returning to Scripture when worry feels heavy.

item.title: Morning prayer Bible verses for a simple beginning
item.description: Begin morning prayer with Psalm 143:8–10 and Lamentations 3:22–23, read their context, and try a simple five-minute practice without rushing.

item.title: What does the Bible say about money?
item.description: Read 1 Timothy 6:6–10 and 6:17–19 to explore money, contentment, misplaced trust, and generosity, with context and questions for everyday choices.

item.title: Psalm 23 meaning: the shepherd and the valley
item.description: Read the complete Psalm 23 and explore its images of a shepherd, rest, the valley, and a table, with simple questions for personal Bible study.

item.title: What does the Bible say about loneliness?
item.description: Read John 14:16–18 and Hebrews 10:24–25 in context, with one small way to ask for company when you feel alone.

item.title: An evening prayer before sleep
item.description: Read Matthew 11:28–30 and 1 Peter 5:6–7, then try a short evening prayer when your day is over and your thoughts are still busy.

item.title: Bible passages for grief and loss
item.description: Read John 11:32–36 and Romans 12:15 in context and find a gentle way to be present with grief after the death of someone you love.

item.title: What does the valley of the shadow of death mean?
item.description: In Psalm 23:4, the valley is a place of real danger. The speaker finds courage in God’s presence while still walking through it.

item.title: Bible Answer is on the App Store
item.description: Bible Answer 1.0 is out for iPhone and iPad, joining the Mac version released on October 28. It is free, with no account, ads or subscriptions, in six languages.

item.title: bibleanswer.app is open in six languages
item.description: The Bible Answer website is live in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Russian, French and Filipino, with a press kit, the privacy policy and support.
